title: Fi Weather-Linked Walk Skip
app: Fi collar, Petkit, Tractive, Petlibro, Litter-Robot, pet cameras, and aquarium controllers via vendor exports, Home Assistant integrations, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fi:activity
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count(eval(walk_logged="true")) as walks, avg(outdoor_temp_c) as outdoor_temp_c by pet _time
| where outdoor_temp_c>32 AND walks=0
| sort - outdoor_temp_c
description: Uses Fi collar walk history telemetry to monitor hot days when a normal walk never happened in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for weather-linked routine breaks that explain lower activity, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Fi collar walk history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily table of hot days with zero walks.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges hot days when a normal walk never happened so you can spot weather-linked routine breaks that explain lower activity before it becomes annoying.
